subject: NovaHealth POC: batching behavior, cost bands, and next steps
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Menon <asha@novahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap — batching expectations, token economics, next steps

Hi Asha — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and what we need to move the POC to proposal: 

Summary of what we heard (please correct me if I missed anything):
- Workload: user-facing clinical summarization API + background batch syncs. Expected average request size ~120 input tokens with ~60 returned tokens (approx 180 tokens/request).
- Traffic: steady-state ~150 qps, daily peaks up to ~650–750 qps during 9–11am ET, with short burst behavior from internal syncs.
- Monthly volume: ballpark you gave of ~1.6–2.0 billion tokens/month across production and pre-prod.
- Budget target: you mentioned a target of roughly $400–$550 per 1M tokens for a committed POC/early volume.

Redwood assumptions & recommended initial config:
- Continuous batching: we expect 25–50ms intentional batch window for low-latency front-end calls, which should yield 6–12x effective token amortization depending on traffic shape.
- Concurrency: reserve a pool to handle 700 qps peak with headroom; recommend dedicated shared pool for the POC to give predictable unit economics.
- Model variant: suggest a quantized Llama-variant for cost baseline; can run a small A/B on a higher-quality variant for quality checks.
- Observability: we’ll enable token-level breakdowns, per-request tail-latency, and KV cache hit metrics during the POC so we can tune batching window vs latency.

Specific asks from us to you before we lock a proposal:
1) A sample 2–3 day traffic dump (timestamped request-size + request rate) — CSV is fine.
2) Confirmation of the $/1M tokens target you can commit to for an initial 3-month POC (you indicated $400–$550; please confirm a firm band).
3) Success criteria: latency SLO (p50/p95 target), quality metrics we should track, and a preferred go/no-go date.

Attachments: I’ve attached nova_workload_v1.csv (call-shaped example skeleton) and will follow up with a cost estimate once we have the actual sample traffic.

Proposed next steps / timeline:
- Tue (9/15): NovaHealth shares sample traffic + success criteria
- Wed (9/16): Redwood shares POC scope and preliminary estimate
- Week of 9/21: POC kickoff (2–4 week run)

If that aligns, we’ll draft the mutual action plan and a preliminary $/1M token estimate.

Thanks — Kim
Kimberly Park
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
---

From: Asha Menon <asha@novahealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: NovaHealth Platform Team <infra@novahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — batching expectations, token economics, next steps

Thanks Kim — this looks right. A few clarifications and data points: 
- Confirmed monthly projected tokens: we estimate ~1.8B tokens/month (mix of inference + background transforms).
- Request shape: median input ~110 tokens / response ~65 tokens (so roughtly 175 tokens/request).
- Peak behavior: short 1–3 minute spikes up to ~700 qps driven by clinician batches; steady daytime at ~140–180 qps.
- Budget: we are aiming for a committed price in the $425–$525 per 1M tokens range for the POC term (3 months) — closer to $425 if there is a caching/batching SLA and visibility into token breakdowns.
- Latency SLO: p95 <= 450ms for interactive calls, p99 < 900ms; background syncs can be relaxed.

I’m attaching a small sample of API logs (sanitized) so you can see qps and token sizes. We can also provide a 48-hour dump if that helps — I’ll try to get that by end of day tomorrow.

Appreciate the clear next steps.
— Asha

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — batching expectations, token economics, next steps

Kim — good note. A few internal action items I’ll own: 
- I’ll pull a quick cost sketch for the $425 and $525 bands using their 1.8B token estimate and two modes: hosted (streaming + continuous batching) vs dedicated (reserved GPU pool + explicit KV cache).
- Ops: propose we design POC with a 30–50ms batch window and a fallback to single-request mode for p99-sensitive endpoints. I’ll include latency tradeoffs in the sketch.
- Legal/Finance: I’ll flag the deal to get preliminary billing language for a 3-month POC with commit.

Rishi — can you add a note on expected memory/kv-cache implications for their 180-token average? I think we’ll need ~12–16GB per replica for optimal KV cache hit rates given their token size.

Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference

---

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Menon <asha@novahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: NovaHealth POC mutual action plan + preliminary estimate

Asha — thanks for the log sample. Attached is a short mutual action plan and an initial estimate (estimate_v1.xlsx). High level: 

Mutual Action Plan (abbreviated)
- 9/16: Redwood shares POC scope + estimate (attached).
- 9/21: Data & access: NovaHealth provides 48h traffic dump + credentials for staging endpoint.
- 9/22: Infrastructure prep: Redwood provisions dedicated pool (warm) and enables observability hooks.
- 9/23: POC kick-off (2 weeks) — run with instrumentation and weekly checkpoints.
- Success criteria: p95 <= 450ms for interactive SLA, token-efficiency improvement >= 4x over naive single-call baseline (measured as effective tokens/second cost), and stable tail-latency under 700 qps spikes.

Preliminary economics (very preliminary until we get full traffic):
- Using your 1.8B token estimate, preliminary ranges: $/1M tokens = $425 (if we achieve continuous batching + KV cache hit >= 30%) — up to $525 if we require higher quality model variant and smaller batching windows. The spreadsheet breaks out dedicated reservation costs vs hosted incremental usage.

Next asks for NovaHealth:
- Confirm the committed $/1M band for the POC (we’ll draft the order form accordingly).
- Share the 48h traffic dump and the list of endpoints that must hit p95 <= 450ms.

We’ll loop in Finance/Legal after you confirm band and we’ll include the POC order form with standard one-time setup and a 3-month commitment term.

Thanks — looking forward to kicking this off.

Kim
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced in thread: nova_workload_v1.csv, sample-api-log.json, estimate_v1.xlsx
